Subject: Follow-up: on-prem / air-gapped qualification items (next steps)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move toward an on-prem, air-gapped plan that meets Legacy Bank’s constraints: 

Summary of what I heard:
- You need Private (on-prem) deployment with an air-gapped option for the most sensitive workloads.
- Offline upgrade windows are required; patching must be performed without outbound internet access.
- Hardware baseline: you currently expect 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs per data-center cluster, but you want guidance on alternatives and sizing for peak inference throughput.
- Auditability: SOC2-style logs, KMS integration, and software supply verification are mandatory.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Sam — can you share the network diagram and the current hardware spec sheet (we can accept a stub for now). You mentioned a security questionnaire is coming; we’ll get our SOC2 artifacts ready.
2) Rishi / Dev — can you pull together a short note on offline upgrade flow, signed-image delivery, and recommended hardware variance (e.g., 8xA100 vs 16xRTX8000) so Sam’s infra team can validate?
3) I’ll schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive next week with your infra/security teams.

I attached a short checklist we typically use for on-prem air-gapped deployments.

Best,

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few details and attaching our network diagram and initial air-gap requirements spreadsheet. Notes inline below: 

- Hardware: current plan is 8x A100 (40GB) per cluster for inference-serving. We have spare rack capacity for expansion to 12 GPUs. Curious what Redwood recommends for fault tolerance and higher QPS.
- Offline upgrades: Our policy is maintenance windows twice per quarter; images are delivered via secure removable media (encrypted USB or isolated transfer point). We cannot allow nodes to pull images directly from the internet.

Subject: Re: Follow-up: on-prem / air-gapped qualification items (technical notes)

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the attachments, they’re helpful. A few technical notes up front based on the details in your spreadsheet and diagram: 

1) Hardware guidance (initial):
- Baseline: 8x A100 (40GB) will support modest production traffic; we estimate ~300 concurrent streams at 16k context assuming optimized batching.
- For higher throughput and headroom we recommend 12–16x A100 or 16x RTX8000 class GPUs with NVLink where available.
- If you prefer cost vs latency tradeoffs, we can supply quantized model variants validated for RTX-class hardware.

2) Offline upgrade flow (air-gapped):
- We support signed, offline-installable images. Typical flow: Redwood provides an image bundle + detached signature. Your infra team verifies signature via our public key, transfers the bundle via removable media into the isolated environment, and performs local install.
- For upgrades we provide a rolling-update plan that can run entirely inside the air-gapped network; we do not require external callbacks.

3) KMS/HSM integration:
- We can integrate with Thales HSM for key wrapping; we’ll need a short integration checklist (ports/agent, ACLs) — I’ll put that in the drive link.

4) Observability and auditability:
- We can ship local audit logs and a periodic signed manifest for ingestion into your SIEM. For customers that cannot export logs off-network, we provide an on-site audit package (signed snapshots) on request.

I’ll work with Dev to produce a one-page hardware and offline-upgrade recommendation by EOD Friday.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Hi Priya / Sam —

Thanks — answering the procurement questions and next steps below so you have everything for your approvals: 

Licensing/pricing:
- Private (on-prem) deployments are contracted as an enterprise Private offering. The base price covers the control plane, runtime licenses, and the private deployment package. Air-gapped delivery and signed-image support are included in the Private offering (no separate per-image fee). Advanced add-ons (long-term retention of audit snapshots, extended on-site support) are priced separately — I can share a formal quote.
- We’ll produce a proposal that includes options for the 8x baseline and a 12/16 GPU configuration so you can compare TCO.

Lead times / procurement cadence:
- Typical lead time for Private engagements: 4–8 weeks from signature to initial delivery (includes security review, provision of signed images, and delivery scheduling).
- If you need faster turnaround we can prioritize and provide a detailed timeline in the SOW.

Technical deep-dive:
- Rishi and Dev will host a 60-min technical deep-dive on Wed 22 Jul at 11:00am ET to go through the offline upgrade flow, HSM integration checklist, and audit/log export options. I’ll send a calendar invite.

- Priya: I’ll follow up with a draft commercial quote and SOW for review; please share your procurement PL timeline if the 4–6 week window is tight.
- Rishi/Dev: please attach the hardware recommendation doc and offline upgrade checklist to the drive link.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
